examples.en: This is a good place for a picnic.
The park is my favourite place in town.
examples.zh: 公园是镇上我最喜欢的地方。

examples.en: Shanghai is a very big city.
examples.zh: 上海是一座很大的城市。

examples.en: The city is busy and noisy.

mnemonic.tip: city 大城市，town 小城镇，village 村庄——从大到小排。

examples.en: Our town has two primary schools.
We went into town to buy shoes.
My grandparents live in a small village.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在一个小村庄。

examples.en: The village is quiet at night.

mnemonic.tip: 谐音「为立志」：山村孩子为立志走出小村庄努力学习。

examples.en: That tall building is a hotel.
The school building is fifty years old.
examples.zh: 学校教学楼有五十年历史了。

mnemonic.tip: build(建造)+ing→建出来的东西，就是建筑物。

examples.en: We fly kites in the park.
You can't park here.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：名词公园，动词停车——car park 就是停车场。

examples.en: Let's go to the cinema on Saturday.
The cinema is next to the bank.

mnemonic.tip: 英式看电影 go to the cinema，美式 go to the movies。

examples.en: We saw a play at the theatre.
examples.zh: 我们在剧院看了一场话剧。

examples.en: The old theatre is in the town centre.

mnemonic.tip: 英式 theatre，美式 theater；cinema 放电影，theatre 演真人。

examples.en: The museum is free on Mondays.
We saw old ships at the museum.
examples.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了古船。

mnemonic.tip: 谐音「缪斯之家」：museum 本意就是缪斯女神的殿堂。

examples.en: The pandas at the zoo are so cute.
examples.zh: 动物园的熊猫太可爱了。

examples.en: Our class visited the zoo last week.
examples.zh: 我们班上周参观了动物园。

mnemonic.tip: zoo 里两个 o 像两只圆眼睛，正盯着动物看。

examples.en: There are cows and sheep on the farm.
We picked strawberries at the farm.
The old castle stands on the hill.
We built a sand castle on the beach.
examples.zh: 我们在沙滩上堆了座沙堡。

mnemonic.tip: castle 的 t 不发音，读 /ˈkɑːsl/；sand castle 沙堡。

examples.en: People dance in the square in the evening.
examples.zh: 晚上人们在广场上跳舞。

examples.en: Draw a square and a circle.
examples.zh: 画一个正方形和一个圆形。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：城市广场多是方形的，所以广场和正方形同一个词。

examples.en: The church bell rings on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日早上教堂的钟声响起。

examples.en: The old church is 300 years old.
examples.zh: 这座老教堂有三百年历史。

mnemonic.tip: church 首尾都是 ch：教堂的两座尖塔立在两头。

examples.en: I posted the letter at the post office.
The post office closes at five.

mnemonic.tip: post(邮寄)+office(办公处)→办邮寄的地方，就是邮局。

examples.en: He took the lost wallet to the police station.
examples.zh: 他把捡到的钱包送到了警察局。

examples.en: The police station is open all night.

mnemonic.tip: police(警察)+station(站)→警察的驻地，就是警察局。

examples.en: The swimming pool opens at eight.
There is a children's pool at the swimming pool.

mnemonic.tip: swimming(游泳)+pool(池)→游泳的池子；口语常简说 the pool。

examples.en: The football stadium holds 60,000 people.
examples.zh: 这座足球场能容纳六万人。

examples.en: The concert is at the city stadium.
examples.zh: 演唱会在市体育场举行。

mnemonic.tip: 谐音「斯泰迪呀」：体育场里呐喊「加油呀」。

examples.en: Our school is on Green Street.
The street is full of little shops.

mnemonic.tip: street 两边有房子的城中街道；road 更宽，多指公路。

examples.en: A narrow path leads to the lake.
examples.zh: 一条窄窄的小路通向湖边。

examples.en: Keep to the path in the forest.
examples.zh: 在森林里要沿着小路走。

mnemonic.tip: path 比 road 小：公园里、林间的小道都是 path。

examples.en: Meet me at the main entrance.
The entrance to the zoo is over there.

mnemonic.tip: enter(进入)+ance(名词后缀)→进入的地方，就是入口。

examples.en: The exit is at the back of the cinema.
Follow the green exit signs.
examples.zh: 跟着绿色的出口标志走。

mnemonic.tip: ex(向外)+it(走)→往外走的口，就是出口。

examples.en: Dad works in an office in the city.
examples.zh: 爸爸在城里的一间办公室工作。

examples.en: The teachers' office is on the first floor.
examples.zh: 教师办公室在二楼（英式一楼）。

examples.en: The factory makes toy cars.
examples.zh: 这家工厂生产玩具汽车。

examples.en: My uncle works in a shoe factory.

mnemonic.tip: fact 来自「制作」：factory 就是制作东西的地方——工厂。

examples.en: You can see the whole city from the tower.
examples.zh: 从塔上能看到整座城市。

examples.en: The clock tower rings every hour.

mnemonic.tip: tower 和 tall 都是 t 开头：塔就是高高(tall)的建筑。

examples.en: The shops are in the town centre.
There is a fountain in the centre of the square.

mnemonic.tip: 英式 centre，美式 center；town centre 市中心。

examples.en: This area of town is very quiet.
The play area is for young children.
examples.zh: 游乐区是给小孩子玩的。

mnemonic.tip: area 读 /ˈeəriə/ 三个音节，别读成「阿瑞亚」。

examples.en: I live near the school.
Is there a bank near here?
How far is the beach from here?
The village is not far from town.

mnemonic.tip: How far…? 问距离；far from 离…远。

examples.en: Turn left at the traffic lights.
The bank is on your left.

mnemonic.tip: turn left 左转，on the left 在左边——问路必备。

examples.en: The hospital is on the right.
That's the right answer!

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：右边和正确——大多数人「右」手写字最「正确」。

examples.en: Go straight on and turn left.
She has long straight hair.

mnemonic.tip: go straight on 一直走——KET 问路场景高频指令。

examples.en: The café is opposite the bookshop.
She sat opposite me on the train.

mnemonic.tip: op(相对)+posite(放)→放在相对的位置，就是对面。

examples.en: The chemist is between the bank and the café.
examples.zh: 药店在银行和咖啡馆之间。

examples.en: I sat between my parents.

mnemonic.tip: be+tween(两个)→夹在两个之间；between A and B。

examples.en: The garden is behind the house.
The cat hid behind the sofa.

mnemonic.tip: be+hind(后部)→在后部，就是在后面。

examples.en: The bus stops in front of the school.
Don't stand in front of the TV!

mnemonic.tip: front 是前面：in front of 在…前面，反义 behind。

examples.en: The bakery is next to the bank.
Can I sit next to you?

mnemonic.tip: next(下一个)+to→就在旁边一个位置，紧挨着。

examples.en: Beijing is in the north of China.
The wind is coming from the north.

mnemonic.tip: 地图上方永远是 north(北)：N 朝上。

examples.en: It is warmer in the south.
Birds fly south in winter.

mnemonic.tip: south 里有 out：太阳从南边「出」来晒得最暖。

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
Shanghai is in the east of China.

mnemonic.tip: East 记 E：Early(早)——太阳最早出现在东方。

examples.en: The sun goes down in the west.
They drove west for two hours.
examples.zh: 他们向西开了两个小时。

mnemonic.tip: west 和 rest(休息)押韵：太阳到西边就「休息」了。

examples.en: There is a lake in the middle of the park.
He woke up in the middle of the night.

mnemonic.tip: in the middle of 在…中间——位置和时间都能用。

examples.en: Write your name at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 在页面底部写上你的名字。

examples.en: The keys were at the bottom of my bag.

mnemonic.tip: top 顶部，bottom 底部：从 top 到 bottom 就是从头到尾。

examples.en: In Britain, cars drive on the left side.
Write on both sides of the paper.

mnemonic.tip: side 家族：inside 里面、outside 外面、beside 旁边。

examples.en: The cinema is at the end of the street.
examples.zh: 电影院在这条街的尽头。

examples.en: The film has a happy end.
examples.zh: 这部电影有个美好的结局。

mnemonic.tip: at the end of 在…尽头/结尾；in the end 最后。

examples.en: Turn right at the corner.
Turn to page ten, please.

mnemonic.tip: turn left/right 转弯；turn on/off 开关；It's your turn 轮到你。

examples.en: We got lost in the old town.
The lost dog found its way home.
examples.zh: 走失的狗自己找到了回家的路。

mnemonic.tip: get lost 迷路；lost 是 lose 的过去分词变形容词。

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the station?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去车站的路吗？

examples.en: This is the best way to learn words.
examples.zh: 这是记单词最好的方法。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：走的路和做事的方法——方法就是「路子」。

examples.en: I looked everywhere for my keys.
There were flowers everywhere in spring.

mnemonic.tip: every(每个)+where(哪里)→每个地方，就是到处。

examples.en: I left my glasses somewhere in the house.
examples.zh: 我把眼镜落在家里某个地方了。

examples.en: Let's go somewhere quiet.
examples.zh: 我们去个安静的地方吧。

mnemonic.tip: some(某个)+where(哪里)→某个地方；否定疑问用 anywhere。

examples.en: I can't find my phone anywhere.
examples.zh: 我哪儿都找不到我的手机。

examples.en: Did you go anywhere in the holidays?

mnemonic.tip: any(任何)+where(哪里)→任何地方；用在否定句和疑问句。

examples.en: The car park is behind the supermarket.
The car park was full on Saturday.

mnemonic.tip: car(汽车)+park(停放)→停汽车的场地；美式叫 parking lot。

examples.en: The fire station is near the bridge.
We visited the fire station on a school trip.
examples.zh: 学校出游时我们参观了消防站。

mnemonic.tip: fire(火)+station(站)→灭火队伍的驻地，就是消防站。

examples.en: Mum goes to the hairdresser's once a month.
examples.zh: 妈妈每月去一次理发店。

examples.en: The hairdresser cut my hair too short!
examples.zh: 理发师把我头发剪太短了！

mnemonic.tip: hair(头发)+dresser(打理者)→打理头发的人；店叫 the hairdresser's。

examples.en: The school disco is on Friday night.
Everyone danced at the disco.
examples.zh: 舞会上每个人都跳了舞。

mnemonic.tip: disco 音译「迪斯科」：英国学校常办 school disco 学生舞会。

examples.en: The leaves fell to the ground.
Don't sit on the wet ground.

mnemonic.tip: playground(操场)、ground floor(一楼) 都有 ground(地面)。

examples.en: The clock is above the door.
The plane flew above the clouds.

mnemonic.tip: above 悬在上方不接触；on 是贴着表面。反义词 below。
